This '''tour guide droid''' was present on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover of Mandalore]]. The hapless droid was welcoming a group of people to Mandalore moments before it was shot multiple times and destroyed by the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].
